chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Patience is of two kinds: patience over what you dislike, and patience against what you covet.

key_terms.تَكْرَهُ: What you dislike or endure with difficulty

ai.seo_question: What are the two types of patience in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) categorizes patience (sabr) into two distinct dimensions: enduring hardship in what one dislikes and restraining oneself from desire in what one loves. This classification highlights that true patience involves both perseverance in adversity and self-control in pleasure, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing external trials with internal desires. The concept underscores the holistic nature of spiritual discipline, where one must remain steadfast not only in suffering but also in avoiding the distractions of worldly pleasures.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 55. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Patience is of two kinds, patience over what pains you, and patience against what you covet.
